features.text: Premium elastic compression technology delivers consistent pressure to reduce swelling and inflammation during intense workouts
Innovative padded patella ring stabilizes your kneecap during dynamic movements, preventing further injury while maintaining mobility
Athletic-grade elastic material provides flexible support that moves with you through sprints, jumps, and explosive movements
Strategic compression zones target key areas to relieve pain from tendonitis and minor sprains during training
Versatile design supports both high-intensity training and everyday activities while managing chronic knee conditions
